output.notes: The paper contributes ALiBi as a position method inserted into the Baevski & Auli LM. It explicitly inherits that LM, but never restates norm type or placement, eps, FFN activation, biases, vocab or the residual form. Those are left not_stated rather than filled in from memory. Consequently the block_ops omit normalisation nodes and the FFN activation, so they are incomplete. Configs: the WikiText-103 247M model (16L/1024/8H/4096) and the CC100 1.3B model (25L/2048/16H/8192). Training length varies by experiment: 64-3072 on WikiText-103 and 512/1024/2048 on CC100. Representative lengths were chosen for context_length. The WikiText model uses adaptive input/softmax (tied); the books model uses a plain tied embedding with a BERT vocabulary of about 29K. ALiBi slopes for n heads form a geometric sequence starting at 2^(-8/n) with that same ratio; they are fixed, not learned. The bias is added before softmax and is not scaled by sqrt(d_k). Head_dim (presumably d/heads) is not stated.
